rules.prepare: # The options of Alpine's recipe. --with-include names the folder that the # headers of utmps themselves go to: it ends up in the flags that # pkg-config gives for libutmps, and that is how a program gets utmpx.h of # utmps in place of the one of the C library. cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" CC="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-gcc" \ ./configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --sysconfdir=/etc \ --libexecdir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/libexec/utmps" \ --enable-shared \ --disable-allstatic \ --with-sysdeps="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/skalibs/sysdeps" \ --with-include="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include/utmps" \ --with-lib="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" \ --with-dynlib="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" \ --enable-pkgconfig \ --enable-utmp
